about.html: Escapes & < > " ' as entities. Unescapes named (©), decimal (©) and hex (©) entities.
about.backslash: String escapes that JSON, JavaScript, Java and C# share: \n, \t, \", \\, \uHHHH. Unescapes every JavaScript escape.
about.unicode: Every character past ASCII as \uHHHH, emoji as a surrogate pair. Unescapes \uHHHH and \u{H…}.
about.hex: Every UTF-8 byte as \xHH. Unescapes \xHH bytes as UTF-8 text.
about.punycode: Domain names, one per line: each label that is not ASCII becomes xn--…, and back.

errors.unknown-entity: There is no HTML entity named {{sequence}}
errors.unknown-escape: {{sequence}} is not an escape sequence. A backslash on its own is written \\
errors.not-utf8: The bytes are not valid UTF-8 text
errors.label-too-long: The label {{sequence}} is longer than 63 characters once encoded
